name: Newcastle Airport
title: Newcastle Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: Newcastle has one terminal and its own Metro station. Here's who flies from it and how to get there.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.airlines: Jet2, easyJet, TUI, Emirates and others
terminals.text: One terminal with one security area. Jet2, easyJet and TUI all have aircraft based here, so early mornings are busiest.

sections.heading: Getting to Newcastle Airport
sections.text:
- **Metro:** the airport has its own station on the Green line, connected to the terminal. It's about 25 minutes from Newcastle city centre.
- **Car:** the airport is about 6 miles north-west of the city, off the A696. The express drop-off by the terminal charges by the minute. A free drop-off zone at Callerton Parkway has a shuttle to the terminal if you allow extra time.

faqs.question: How do you get from Newcastle to the airport by Metro?
faqs.answer: Take the Green line to Airport. It takes about 25 minutes from the city centre.
